card.name: Digits after a decimal point
card.fires_on: A single digit right after the decimal point in a number such as 45.7, 0.1 or 385.0. It appears in measurements, rounding rules, ranges and tables.

modes.label: Rounding and precision
modes.description: The first or second digit after the point when a precision or rounding step is given.

modes.label: Data values
modes.description: A decimal digit inside a measured value, range or table entry.

card.writes: It suppresses the period and the word adult, which fits a digit being expected next rather than a sentence end.
card.plain: It fires on the digit just after the decimal point in a number.
